title: Identification of an Evolutionarily Conserved Allosteric Network in Steroid Receptors.
authors: Dube, Namita; Khan, Sabab Hasan; Sasse, Riley; Okafor, C Denise
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟和次优路径分析研究类固醇受体的别构网络，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关受体但未聚焦TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移至蛋白-核酸互作机制研究。
abstract: Allosteric pathways in proteins describe networks comprising amino acid residues which may facilitate the propagation of signals between distant sites. Through inter-residue interactions, dynamic and conformational changes can be transmitted from the site of perturbation to an allosteric site. While sophisticated computational methods have been developed to characterize such allosteric pathways linking specific sites on proteins, few attempts have been made to apply these approaches toward identifying new allosteric sites. Here, we use molecular dynamics simulations and suboptimal path analysis to discover new allosteric networks in steroid receptors with a focus on evolutionarily conserved pathways. Using modern receptors and a reconstructed ancestral receptor, we identify networks connecting several sites to the activation function surface 2 (AF-2), the site of coregulator recruitment. One of these networks is conserved across the entire family, connecting a predicted allosteric site located between helices 9 and 10 of the ligand-binding domain. We investigate the basis of this conserved network as well as the importance of this site, discovering that the site lies in a region of the ligand-binding domain characterized by conserved inter-residue contacts. This study suggests an evolutionarily importance of the helix 9-helix 10 site in steroid receptors and identifies an approach that may be applied to discover previously unknown allosteric sites in proteins.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质中的变构通路描述了由氨基酸残基组成的网络，这些残基可能促进远距离位点之间信号的传播。通过残基间相互作用，动态和构象变化可以从扰动位点传递到变构位点。尽管已开发出复杂的计算方法来表征连接蛋白质上特定位点的此类变构通路，但将这些方法应用于识别新变构位点的尝试却很少。在此，我们使用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和次优路径分析来发现类固醇受体中的新变构网络，重点关注进化上保守的通路。利用现代受体和重建的祖先受体，我们识别出连接多个位点至激活功能表面2 (activation function surface 2, AF-2)（辅调节因子招募位点）的网络。其中一个网络在整个家族中保守，连接位于配体结合域螺旋9和10之间的预测变构位点。我们研究了该保守网络的基础以及该位点的重要性，发现该位点位于配体结合域中一个以保守残基间接触为特征的区域。这项研究表明，螺旋9-螺旋10位点在类固醇受体中具有进化重要性，并确定了一种可能用于发现蛋白质中先前未知变构位点的方法。
